'''Kris Dow''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2001 Framingham tournament]] on 7 April 2001 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|COTVG]], according to Hayes Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2075">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-15-mass-states-double-trd2075/ mass-states-double-tr], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 15 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-15-mass-states-double-trd2075/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
